name: Keep templates declarative and free of ad-hoc presentation
statement: Keep templates declarative: use Angular control flow and bindings, expose prepared view state, avoid complex expressions, and keep presentation in component styles rather than inline style attributes.
rationale: Small declarative templates keep rendering behavior legible, testable, and compatible with shared styling. Quality Studio templates bind prepared signals and use modern control-flow blocks.

history.change: Initial template-hygiene rule based on Quality Studio signal-backed templates.
